name: eBay TV Clean View
description: Clean eBay listings with larger text and reduced clutter for TV browsing

params.css: .ad, [class*='merch'], [class*='sponsored'], .gh-eb-Geo, [class*='ux-seller-section__banner'] { display: none !important; } .x-item-title { font-size: 28px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; } .x-price-primary span { font-size: 36px !important; font-weight: 900 !important; color: #34d399 !important; } .ux-textspans { font-size: 16px !important; line-height: 1.7 !important; } .vim .d-item-description p { font-size: 18px !important; line-height: 1.7 !important; } img.s-item__image-img { border-radius: 8px !important; }
